blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some customs brokers and truckers are expected to halt operations today at Manila’s ports in a voluntary “rest day” protest over what they say is foreign shipping lines’ failure to address a mounting backlog of empty containers that has disrupted cargo flows since 2025.
